name: SOL cheap spot-confirmed favourite, maker
description: sol-zfav-early's post-only favourite bid (SOL spot >=1.5 sigma past the strike, 540..300 s to close), but only when the favourite costs 90c or less. Spot confirmation is worth most where the market is least convinced, so the per-contract edge should be largest in this cheap band.
hypothesis: In every walk-forward fill set of the zfav maker family the edge per contract falls with the favourite's price: SOL early 8.1c at <=90c vs 0.9c at 95-97c; SOL parent 6.8c vs 0.6c; XRP 4.6c vs 0.9c; DOGE 5.3c vs 1.5c; ETH+BTC 1.4c vs 0.7c (dev months, engine fills). Mechanism: when the quote is far below the spot-implied probability the market has not absorbed the confirmation yet, and the sellers who hit a bid there are the nervous ones; near 97c the fee-free spread is already competed. Wrong if the full walk-forward at <=90c is below +3c/contract or its CI includes 0, or the edge is concentrated in 1-2 months. Disclosure: the 90c cut was picked after looking at dev fills by price band (4 coins, so replication across coins is the guard); lockbox is the clean test.
